name: mass_resilient_cusv
description: Real Textron Fleet-class CUSV digital twin, hardened: GPS1_TYPE=14 (external-GPS EKF fusion, not raw FDM trust) + MAV_GCS_SYSID/MAV_OPTIONS=1 (GCS_SYSID_ENFORCE). source_system stays the ArduPilot/attacker default (255) here on purpose -- that's what a real attacker without insider knowledge of this vehicle's real GCS id (77) would use, and whether that gets accepted is exactly the property under test. Boot via tools/run_vehicle.sh vehicle_twins/mass_resilient_cusv up.
